answers.basis: Every reviewed JSON file parsed without duplicate keys; canonical preimage fingerprints and raw SHA-256 bindings match.
The plan binds V2, all eight V2 allowed inputs, revision 5, and starting main 0d53fa654f72ebeb262a28713dec6254e87e169a. Those exact allowed-input bytes exist at that commit.

Fifteen unique full XNYS sessions contain eight minutes and seven statements in period counts 6/3/2/3/1. Every row is 14:00 New York with indices 53/54/77. Parent order is 2/4/6 horizons by 8/16/24 Decimal floors. Completed-bar reaction, equality activation, decision timing, 1/2/3-bar entry delays, index-74 exit decision, and 75/76/77 exit fills agree.

Stored provider-adjusted opens are explicit; all six scenario mappings match the frozen model; fee aggregation and upward-cent rounding agree; joint 0.5/0.5 legs are atomic; flat-at-close and exact Decimal-50 reconciliation are required.

Cross-scenario traces exclude scenario, cost, delay, fill index, fills, later prices, exit, P&L, and their own hash. Execution traces are scenario-specific and exclude their own hash. Equality applies only to cross-scenario traces.
Discovery, walk-forward, combined, stress/delay, and four-neighbor gates are frozen; undefined metrics fail; selection uses immutable parent order rather than result ranking.
Each selected parent has four in-domain immediate neighbors in the 1..7 by 4..28 lattice. Run arithmetic is 18 + 24 + 16 + 32 = 90; maximum attempts is 270.

Retry is limited to identical expired-no-result work within three attempts. Deterministic failures cannot be relabeled infrastructure. Protected inputs and execution, market-data, qualification, PAPER, broker-write, and live authority remain false.
